description: This file declares the HandleBusMessage class, which is a task for handling GStreamer bus messages within the WebAudio component of the Rialto server. It includes class members for context, player, client, and message handling, and defines the interface for executing the task.

classes.name: HandleBusMessage
classes.description: A class representing a task to handle GStreamer bus messages for WebAudio playback, encapsulating context, player, client, and message data.

methods.name: HandleBusMessage
methods.description: Constructor initializing the task with context, player, client, wrappers, and message.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the task to handle the GStreamer bus message.
